answer: Tenure weight is guarded by a narrow canyon one key crosses at a time. Each identity extends a sequential cipher chain bound to its own staked history, one step per settled epochs, each step backed by a 200 POA bond held in escrow. A fresh key waits in a probation queue and earns weight quadratic in tenure, while peers audit random steps; a failed audit will slash the bond, burn the holdback deposit and drop weight to zero. To forge ten histories an operator must fund ten bonds, run ten clocks and pay ten serial delays for one unit of weight.
